logp.method_description: The shaking flask method was used to determine the log Po/w of these compounds in accordance with the published protocol. For 24 hours, we utilized an orbital shaker to combine a measured amount of each chemical with water that had been saturated with n-octanol. For 10 minutes, the solution was centrifuged at 3000 rpm to separate its components. After separating the bilayers, we used UV-Vis spectroscopy to learn more about the complexes, and we calculated the partition coefficient values (log Po/w) by measuring the optical density (OD) of the complexes in water and octanol.
